lin.name: the track series (Track Diagram)
lin.idea: the family's week drawn as a signal box's illuminated track diagram: steel lines on slate boards with a lamp at each stop, drawn only where there is an order (Coming up, To do, the setup steps, the chat); the series began as Signal Box (round 7) and its mimic-line language

changes: bring back the original Phosphor page's light wherever this design shows phosphor: every effect in phosphor_kit.md that fits it, in this design's own terms
the machine's voice as lit phosphor: Vera's words, times and live readouts with a soft halo, while the family's words stay grounded and sharp
glowing dots on the black: the live lamps and status lights as small green points that glow and breathe, and a faint field of phosphor dots where the machine speaks
